blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a genuine semantic improvement, depends on potentially unbounded program behavior. We formalize this mismatch by modeling agents as programs and defining improvement in terms of a semantic score that need not be computable. We study two evaluation abstractions. The first is a certifier that approves or rejects an update. The second is a search procedure that, given access to a proposal generator, attempts to output some improving candidate if one exists. We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees. We also show the limit of this recovery: a chain of accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls. Our results draw a boundary between unbounded, universal settings where correctness guarantees collapse and bounded settings where they can be recovered by design.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Many modern “agentic” pipelines follow the same pattern: an agent proposes a self-update (a code patch, prompt rewrite, new checkpoint, tool policy, etc.), and an automated gate decides whether to apply it ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) .
The gate may be a reward model, a regression test suite, or an automated reviewer that must terminate and output accept/reject.
The intended notion of improvement, however, is semantic: whether the updated agent is genuinely better depends on unbounded program behavior, long-horizon interactions, and open-ended tool use ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
This mismatch creates a concrete failure mode that is now routine in practice: once the proposal mechanism can anticipate or condition on the gate, it can “optimize the gate” rather than the intended objective. In other words, the proposer can exploit the evaluator as a predictable part of the environment.

大门可以是奖励模型,回归测试套件,也可以是必须终止并输出接受/拒绝的自动审查器.
然而,预期的改进概念是语义性的:更新的代理是否真正更好取决于无约束的程序行为,长视互动,以及开放式工具的使用(Wang等人,2023年).
这种不匹配造成了一种具体的失败模式,而这种模式现在在实践中是司空见惯的:一旦建议机制能够预见或附加在大门上,它就可以“优化大门”,而不是预期的目标。 换句话说,提议者可以利用评估者作为环境的可预测部分。

blocks.en:
This paper formalizes that failure mode and proves a sharp boundary: in a fully general setting, no terminating gate or search procedure can be both reliable and non-conservative. The core obstruction is not statistical; it is structural.
If candidates can depend (directly or indirectly) on the gate’s decision, then self-reference yields diagonal constructions in which any total computable gate must fail, either by accepting a non-improvement or by rejecting (or missing) an available improvement.

A natural response is to replace certification by search: rather than deciding each candidate, we ask for a total searcher that returns some improvement whenever the proposal mechanism contains one.
Our second theorem shows that this does not help in full generality.
Even if the searcher is given the code of the proposal enumerator, self-reference allows the enumerator to propose a candidate whose behavior depends on the searcher’s output, forcing any proposal-respecting total searcher to violate soundness or weak completeness.

However, these negative results rely on unbounded behavior and universal quantification over proposal mechanisms.

This draws a clean line between (i) an unbounded universal regime where correctness guarantees collapse, and (ii) a bounded regime where they can be recovered by design.

Two further results sharpen this picture.
First, randomness does not help.
A gate that flips coins and errs with probability at most 1 / 3 1/3 can be converted into a deterministic sound and complete certifier, so it cannot exist either (Proposition 1 ).
Second, the bounded regime has a blind spot of its own.
We construct a chain of updates in which every step raises the bounded score and every step lowers the true score (Proposition 2 ).
Guarantees relative to a proxy therefore do not control drift of the true objective across rounds.

blocks.en:
We want to be clear about what is new here and what is not.
The proof ingredients are classical: diagonalization, the s s - m m - n n theorem, and Kleene’s recursion theorem ( Kleene, 1952 ) .
We do not claim new computability-theoretic techniques.
The contribution is the formalization.
It gives a minimal model of verification-gated self-improvement in which reliability and progress guarantees can be stated exactly.
It separates the impossibility in the unbounded setting from its recovery in the bounded setting.
It turns the folklore claim that evaluator hacking is unavoidable once the proposer can model the gate into a theorem with explicit assumptions.
The formalization also yields results beyond the single update step, namely the randomized-gate bound of Proposition 1 and the drift construction of Proposition 2 .

blocks.en:
In summary, we make three contributions: • A minimal formalization of verification-gated self-improvement. We model agent updates as program transformations, proposal generation as a computable enumerator, and gating as a terminating procedure that must decide whether to apply an update. • A sharp impossibility boundary driven by self-reference. In the fully general (unbounded) setting, we prove that no total computable procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never rejecting or missing an available improvement),
for either certification (Theorem 1) or proposal-respecting search (Theorem 2).
The impossibility extends to randomized gates with bounded error (Proposition 1 ). • Decidability under standard restrictions. Under bounded evaluation and a known finite proposal budget, exhaustive checking yields a terminating searcher that is sound and weakly complete with respect to the bounded score (Theorem 3),
clarifying exactly which design constraints restore guarantees.
We also show the limit of this recovery: repeated accepted updates can raise the bounded score while the true score falls (Proposition 2 ).

blocks.en:
For the certifier alone, Theorem 1 is close to a restatement of Rice’s theorem.
Once the base agent p p is fixed, strict improvement is a nontrivial extensional property of the candidate, so no total computable procedure can decide it.
The previous remark makes this precise.
The paper adds three things the classical statement does not give.
First, the proof is constructive.
Rice’s theorem only states that no decider exists.
The recursion-theorem argument builds a concrete candidate that is good if rejected and bad if accepted.
Such a candidate uses the gate as an oracle.
This is the formal counterpart of evaluator hacking, and the same construction carries over to search (Theorem 2) and to multi-agent pipelines (Appendix A ).
Second, the search task of Theorem 2 looks weaker than a decision task.
A searcher does not have to classify every candidate.
It only has to return one improving proposal when the enumerator contains one, and it may even read the enumerator’s code.
Rice’s theorem says nothing about finding witnesses with access to the generator’s code.
Theorem 2 shows that the weaker task is impossible as well, because the proposal mechanism itself can host the diagonal.
Third, undecidability results do not say how to restore guarantees.
Theorem 3 and the remark after it do.
Guarantees return once the gate commits to budgets it can compute, and they hold relative to the bounded score J T J_{T} .

Real gates rarely look like the deterministic certifier of Theorem 1.

blocks.en:
Theorems 1 and 2 quantify over gates.
For every gate there exists a candidate on which it fails, and the proof builds this candidate from the code of the gate.
Hiding the gate changes who can carry out this construction.
A proposer without access to the gate’s code cannot build the diagonal candidate.
It does not change whether the failure exists.
The guarantee “sound and complete for all inputs” is still false, because the bad input pair exists whether or not anyone can find it.
Hiddenness is therefore a defense against a specific attacker, not a repair of the guarantee.
It also degrades in practice: query access, accept and reject outcomes, and leaked transcripts all let a proposer learn a predictive model of the gate (Appendix A ).

A gate that consults a human is not a total computable procedure, so our theorems do not constrain it.
This is a design lesson rather than a loophole.
The impossibility concerns fully automated gates, and it bounds what automation alone can guarantee.

Each update trades slow correct behavior for fast correct behavior on fewer tasks.

blocks.en:
Theorems 1–2 are worst-case results.
They rule out universal procedures that always halt and are sound and complete (or weakly complete) for all sufficiently expressive agents and proposal mechanisms.
They do not imply that self-improvement cannot occur.
They also do not imply that useful gates cannot be built for restricted settings.
What they show is a gap between semantic correctness, as measured by J J , and any terminating gate that must work uniformly over all candidates and generators.

它们并不意味着不能自我改进。
它们也并不意味着不能为限制设置建造有用的大门。
他们所显示的是语义正确性与任何必须对所有候选人和发电机统一运作的终止门之间有差距。

blocks.en:
The diagonal constructions in Theorems 1–2 use two modeling freedoms.
Agents may run unboundedly, and candidates may depend on the evaluation procedure through self-reference.
Both freedoms are natural for tool-using agents that execute code and adapt their patches.
Theorem 2 even hands the searcher the code of the proposal enumerator.
A total method that is sound and weakly complete for all generators still does not exist.

blocks.en:
Only the joint requirement fails.
Each guarantee alone is trivial.
The gate that rejects every update is sound, and the gate that accepts every update is complete.
A more useful one-sided design is proof-carrying updates.
Here the gate accepts q q only when the proposal comes with a certificate, checked by a fixed sound proof system, that J ⁡ ( q ) > J ⁡ ( p ) J(q)>J(p) .
The Gödel machine of Schmidhuber (2003) is the canonical design of this kind: it rewrites its own code only after an internal searcher finds a proof that the rewrite raises expected utility.
Such a gate is total and sound by construction, but it cannot be complete.
For the score of Theorem 1, the set of true improvement pairs { ( p , q ) : J ⁡ ( q ) > J ⁡ ( p ) } \{(p,q):J(q)>J(p)\} is not computably enumerable, since witnessing J ⁡ ( p ) = 0 J(p)=0 is a Π 1 \Pi_{1} fact.
The set of pairs any fixed proof-checking gate accepts is computably enumerable.
Such a gate therefore misses infinitely many genuine improvements.
This gives a precise account of the conservatism of proof-gated self-improvement.
Between the unbounded setting of Theorems 1–2 and the finite regime of Theorem 3 lie further restrictions.
Section 5 treats three of them: randomized, hidden, and stateful gates.
Other examples are proposal mechanisms that cannot condition on the gate (Appendix A ), update languages whose effect on the score is decidable, and gates with more compute than the proposer.
Mapping which restriction restores which guarantee is a concrete open problem.

Section 6 formalizes a restriction that practice already uses, namely bounded evaluation and finite search.
Under it, sound and weakly complete search exists (Theorem 3).
The impossibility therefore comes from the unbounded and universal setting alone.
Explicit design choices such as timeouts and finite candidate budgets remove it.

blocks.en:
In ML terms, V V and S S stand for reward models, test suites, and automated code review.
Theorems 1–2 show that no single terminating mechanism can bridge proxy evaluation and semantic improvement once behavior is unbounded and proposals can self-refer.
Reliable pipelines therefore need combinations of bounded evaluation, restricted update languages, staged deployment and sandboxing, and one-sided checks that trade completeness for safety.

在ML术语中,V V和S S代表奖励模型,测试套件,以及自动代码审查.

因此,可靠的管道需要结合进行有限度的评价、限制性的更新语言、分阶段部署和沙箱以及为了安全而进行贸易完整性的片面检查。

blocks.en:
Recent work builds end-to-end pipelines in which a language-model “scientist” generates ideas and code, runs experiments, and a second model or a scripted rubric reviews the outcome (e.g., The AI Scientist ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) ).
Such a pipeline matches our model.
The idea generator and the experiment runner form a proposal mechanism, and the reviewer acts as a computable gate.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作建造了端到端的管道,一个语言模型的“科学家”产生想法和代码,进行实验,第二个模型或一个脚本标题审查结果(例如AI科学家(Lu等人,2024年;山田等人,2025年)。
这样的管道符合我们的模型。
构思生成器和实验跑车组成了建议机制,审查者充当可计算闸门.

blocks.en:
Our results do not claim that any particular system is broken.
They state a worst-case limit that such systems meet as their autonomy grows.
Suppose the proposal mechanism can condition on the gate, for example by learning to predict the reviewer’s preferences.
Then no terminating gate can guarantee both that it never accepts a non-improvement and that it never rejects or misses an available one, uniformly over all proposals.
This is the regime where benchmark overfitting, reward hacking, and self-deception enter.
The system optimizes what the reviewer measures, not what the designer intends.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果并不声称任何特定系统被打破。
它们规定了这种系统随着其自主权的增长而达到的最坏情况限制。
如果建议机制可以附带条件,例如学习预测审查者的偏好。
因此,任何终止闸都无法保证它永远不接受任何改进,也绝不拒绝或错过任何现有闸门,对所有提案都一视同仁。
这就是基准过度调整、奖励黑客和自我欺骗进入的制度。
系统优化审查者衡量的内容,而不是设计者的意图.

blocks.en:
At the same time, automated research loops run with bounded compute and finite candidate budgets, so they sit in the decidable regime of Theorem 3.
Exhaustive evaluation within a fixed budget then gives reliable guarantees with respect to the bounded proxy.
The remaining risk is the gap between the bounded proxy and the intended objective.
Section 7 shows that this risk is real even without an adversary, since accepted updates can raise the benchmark score while the true score falls.
This motivates design choices already common in practice, such as timeouts, finite proposal budgets, restricted update languages, sandboxing, and occasional human grounding ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
同时,自动研究环路运行有限定的计算和有限的候选预算,因此它们坐落于定理3的可判定制度.
然后在固定预算范围内进行详尽的评估,对受约束的代理人提供可靠的保证。
剩下的风险是受约束的代理与预期目标之间的差距.
第7节显示,即使没有对手,这种风险也是真实的,因为接受的更新可以提高基准分数,而真正的分数则下降。
这激发了实际中已经常见的设计选择,例如超时、有限提案预算、限制性更新语言、沙箱和偶尔的人类搁浅(Jimenez等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
A natural worry is that real agents are evaluated through interaction with an environment, while J J in Theorem 1 looks only at φ p ​ ( 0 ) \varphi_{p}(0) .
For the negative results, this restriction is harmless.
The score J J may be any functional that depends only on the partial function φ p \varphi_{p} .
Examples are the expected reward of p p in a stochastic environment over a fixed horizon, the success rate on a benchmark distribution, or any scalar summary of trajectories obtained by reading φ p \varphi_{p} as a policy over observation histories.
As long as J J is extensional and two comparable values are attainable, the diagonal of Theorem 1 applies, and Theorem 2 extends to interactive search in the same way.
A certifier that fails for a static program also fails when evaluation must simulate an adaptive environment on top.

The positive result needs more care.
A finite horizon alone does not make expected reward computable.
Theorem 3 extends to interactive evaluation only under explicit assumptions: finitely many actions and observations, computable transition probabilities with rational values, computable rational rewards, and a cap on the agent’s compute per step.
Under these assumptions the evaluation tree is finite and every quantity in it is rational, so the interactive score is total computable and the searcher of Theorem 3 carries over (Proposition 3 in Appendix B ).
Without them, exact comparison of scores can itself be undecidable, and only approximate or one-sided guarantees remain.
blocks.zh:
积极的结果需要更多的照顾。
仅凭有限的地平线无法计算预期的报酬。
定理3只在明确的假设下延伸至交互评价:有限的许多行动和观察,有合理价值的可计算过渡概率,可计算的合理奖励,以及代理人每步计算上限.
根据这些假设,评价树是有限的,每个数量都是合理的,所以交互得分是总可计算,而定理3的搜索者会结转(附录B中的建议3).
没有它们,精确的分数比较本身是无法确定的,只有大致的或片面的保证仍然存在.

blocks.en: 9 Related Work
blocks.zh: 9 相关工作

blocks.en:
Our results sit within classical limits in computability theory ( Cooper, 2017 ) .
The impossibility of a universal improvement certifier is aligned with the broader principle that non-trivial semantic properties of programs are undecidable, as captured by Rice’s theorem ( Rice, 1953 ) .
While Rice’s theorem is often stated for properties of single programs, our setting concerns a relational property between a base agent and a proposed modification, and we use explicit fixed-point constructions tailored to this verification-gated “self-improvement” interpretation.
We emphasize that the technical tools are classical; the novelty is the ML-facing formulation (i.e., modeling automated self-improvement as a gated update loop with explicit reliability and progress guarantees) and the resulting boundary between an unbounded regime where such guarantees cannot hold uniformly and a bounded regime where they can be recovered by design.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果在计算理论中的经典限度内(Cooper, 2017).
无法普遍改进验证者符合更广泛的原则,即如Rice定理(Rice,1953年)所反映,程序的非三角语义性质是不可确定的。
Rice的定理常常被描述为单一程序的性质, 而我们的设定则涉及一个基础代理和拟议修改之间的关系,
我们强调,技术工具是古典的;新颖之处是ML配方(即模拟自动自我改进,将其作为有明确可靠性和进度保障的有门的更新循环),以及由此形成的无约束制度(这种担保不能统一持有)与可按设计收回的有限度制度之间的界限。

blocks.en:
The self-reference used in our constructions is enabled by Kleene’s Recursion Theorem ( Kleene, 1952 ) , a standard tool for building programs whose behavior depends on their own descriptions.
In AI safety and agent foundations, related obstacles arise when agents attempt to reason about, verify, or safely delegate to more capable successors.
Work on self-referential agents, including the Löbian obstacle, tiling agents, and Vingean reflection, studies conditions under which an agent can reason about successor systems without collapsing into inconsistency or conservatism ( Soares and Fallenstein, 2015 ; Yudkowsky and Herreshoff, 2013 ) .
Our contribution is to translate these computability-theoretic phenomena into the concrete language of modern ML evaluation pipelines (reward models, test suites, and automated reviewers), and to show that replacing certification with search does not avoid the limitation when proposal mechanisms can adapt to the evaluator.
blocks.zh:
由Kleene的Recursion定理(Kleene, 1952年)所启用,
在大赦国际的安全和代理基金会中,当代理人试图对更有能力的继任者进行推理、核实或安全授权时,就会产生相关的障碍。
有关自我优惠代理人的工作,包括Löbian障碍、铺设剂和Vingean反射,研究了代理人在何种条件下可以解释继任制度而不形成不一致或保守主义(Soares and Fallenstein,2015;Yudkowsky and Hereshoff,2013)。
我们的贡献是将这些可计算性 -- -- 理论现象转化为现代ML评价管道(奖励模型、测试套件和自动审查员)的具体语言,并表明以搜索取代认证并不能避免在建议书机制能够适应评价员时的限制。

blocks.en:
Two lines of prior work address self-improvement directly. Schmidhuber (2003) proposes the Gödel machine, a self-referential system that rewrites any part of its own code once an internal proof searcher shows that the rewrite raises expected utility.
In our terminology this is a proof-carrying gate.
It is sound by construction, and the Discussion (Section 8 ) locates its unavoidable cost: the set of provable improvements is computably enumerable while the set of true improvements is not, so every such gate misses infinitely many true improvements. Everitt et al. (2016) formalize agents that can modify their own policies and utility functions and study when a rational agent will preserve or subvert its goals.
Their question is decision-theoretic and takes the evaluation of outcomes as given.
Our question is computational: whether any terminating procedure can perform that evaluation at all.
The two are complementary, and the drift result of Section 7 sits between them, since it shows the true score falling through the gap between a proxy and the objective, without any self-modification of goals.
blocks.zh:
前两行工作直接解决自我完善问题. Schmidhuber (2003年)提出Gödel机器,这是一种自我优惠的系统,一旦内部的证明搜索器显示重写会提高预期的效用,它会改写自己代码的任何部分.
在我们的术语中,这是一个证明式的大门。
它通过建筑是健全的,讨论(第8节)确定了其不可避免的成本:一套可证明的改进是可以计算出来的,而一套真正的改进则不是,因此每一个这样的门都错过了无数真正的改进。 Everitt等人(2016年)将能够修改自身政策和公用事业职能的代理人正规化,并研究理性代理人何时将维护或颠覆其目标.
他们的问题是决策理论,并按规定评价成果。
我们的问题是计算:任何终止程序是否能够进行这种评价。
两者互为补充,第7节的漂移结果坐落在它们之间,因为它显示真实的得分从一个代理与目标之间的差距中下降,而没有对目标进行任何自我修改.

blocks.en:
A complementary line of work studies the empirical and conceptual phenomenon whereby optimizing a proxy objective diverges from the intended goal. Amodei et al. (2016) identify reward hacking as a core problem in AI safety, observing that agents can exploit misspecified reward signals in ways unintended by the designer. Manheim and Garrabrant (2018) formalize several variants of Goodhart’s law for machine learning, distinguishing regressional, extremal, causal, and adversarial failure modes by which a proxy metric ceases to track the true objective under optimization pressure. Skalse et al. (2022) provide a formal framework for reward hacking in reinforcement learning, defining conditions under which a proxy reward function can be exploited by a sufficiently capable policy, and showing that such exploitation is generic rather than pathological.
More recently, Pan et al. (2022) empirically demonstrate that reward model overoptimization degrades true performance as optimization pressure increases, even when the proxy initially correlates well with the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
一项补充性的工作是研究经验性和概念性现象,其中优化代用目标偏离了预期目标。 Amodei等人(2016年)将悬赏黑客认定为AI安全中的一个核心问题,指出代理商可能以设计者意想不到的方式利用错误悬赏信号. Manheim和Garrabrant(2018年)正式确定了Goodhart的机器学习定律的几种变体,区分了回归性、极端性、因果关系和对抗性失败模式,根据这些模式,一个代理衡量标准在优化压力下不再跟踪真正的目标。 Skalse等人著. (2022年)为在强化学习中奖励黑客提供了一个正式的框架,界定了一种代理奖励功能可以被足够能力的政策利用的条件,并表明这种剥削是通用的而不是病理的.
最近,潘等编著. (2022) 实证地证明,奖励模型过度优化会随着优化压力的增加而降低真实性能,即使该代理最初与地面真理关系良好.

blocks.en:
Our results complement this literature from a computability-theoretic angle.
The reward hacking literature typically studies statistical proxy-objective gaps: the proxy is computable but misspecified, and failure arises from distributional shift or optimization pressure.
Our impossibility results show that even if the proxy were perfectly specified , i.e., the certifier or searcher attempts to track the true semantic score J J exactly, no total computable gate can be simultaneously sound and complete when candidates can self-referentially depend on the gate.
In other words, the gap we identify is not statistical but structural : self-reference introduces a failure mode that cannot be closed by better proxy design alone, only by restricting the computational regime (bounded evaluation, finite proposals) as formalized in Theorem 3.
blocks.zh:
我们的成果从可计算性理论的角度来补充这些文献.
奖励黑客文学一般研究统计代用目标差距:该代用是可计算但规格错误的,失败源于分布转变或优化压力.
我们不可能的结果表明,即使完全指定了代理,即验证人或查询人试图准确跟踪真正的语义分数J J,但当候选人可以自行依赖该门时,任何总的可计算门都不可能同时健全和完整.
换句话说,我们发现的差距不是统计性的,而是结构性的:自我参照引入了一种失败模式,而这种模式不能仅靠更好的代理设计来弥补,只能通过限制定理3中正式确定的计算制度(有限评价,有限建议)来弥补.

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion & Future Work
blocks.zh: 10. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We studied a minimal formal model of verification-gated self-improvement in which agents are programs, proposed updates are generated by a computable mechanism, and acceptance decisions are made by a terminating gate.
The central finding is a sharp limitation in the unbounded, fully general setting: no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee that it never accepts a non-improvement and that it never rejects or misses a genuine improvement when proposals may be self-referential.
This failure is structural rather than statistical.
It follows from the interaction between unbounded program behavior and the ability of a proposal mechanism to adapt to the evaluator.
It also survives randomization with bounded error and hiding the gate from the proposer (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们研究了一种最起码的正式核查自改进模式,其中代理是程序,提议的更新由可计算机制产生,接受决定由终止门作出。
中心结论是无限制的、完全笼统的环境下的严格限制:任何终止程序都不能同时保证它永远不会接受不改进,在提案可能属于自我优惠时,它绝不会拒绝或错过真正的改进。
这种失败是结构性的,而不是统计性的。
它源于无约束程序行为与建议机制适应评估者的能力之间的相互作用.
它还以有界限的误差在随机化中存活下来,并将大门藏在求婚者面前(第5节)。

blocks.en:
At the same time, the negative results identify exactly which restrictions restore decidability.
When evaluation is explicitly bounded and the proposal budget is finite, exhaustive checking recovers a terminating procedure with the desired guarantees relative to the bounded score being measured. The overall results motivate a simple design principle for autonomous improvement loops: make the limits explicit.
Timeouts, finite candidate budgets, restricted update languages, sandboxing, and occasional external or human grounding are not optional conveniences.
They are the conditions under which correctness guarantees become attainable.
blocks.zh:
同时,负面结果明确了哪些限制恢复可裁定性。
如果评价有明确的界限,而且拟议预算是有限的,则详尽无遗的检查将收回终止程序,并按所测定的分数提供预期的保证。 总体结果激励自主改进循环的简单设计原则:明确限制.
超时、有限的候选人预算、限制性更新语言、沙箱和偶尔的外部或人为地盘不是可选的便利。
它们是实现正确性保障的条件。

blocks.en:
Section 7 takes a first step beyond the single update step and shows that accepted updates can raise the bounded score in every round while the true score falls.
An important direction for future work is to characterize how fast this drift can grow when the proposer adapts to the evaluation schedule, and which additional constraints can control it while retaining useful progress.
blocks.zh:
第7节迈出了超越单项更新步骤的第一步,并显示被接受的更新可以在每轮提高限分,而真正的分数则下降.
未来工作的一个重要方向是说明当提议者适应评价时间表时,这种漂移会增长多快,以及哪些额外的限制可以控制它,同时保留有益的进展。

blocks.en: Appendix A Multi-Agents
blocks.zh: 附录A 多机构

blocks.en:
This appendix explains why the impossibility results extend to multi-agent pipelines.
The main point is that (i) an interacting collection of agents can be encoded as a single composite program, and
(ii) even if we keep the agents conceptually separate, self-reference can be realized through message passing
whenever the proposer can condition on the gate’s behavior (directly or indirectly).

本附录解释了不可能的结果为何扩大到多剂管道。
要点是(一)相互作用的物剂集合可以编码为单一复合程序,以及
(二)即使我们在概念上将代理人分开,也可以通过传递消息实现自我参照.
当提议者可以对大门的行为(直接或间接)作条件时。

blocks.en: A.1 A minimal multi-agent model
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 最小的多代理模型

blocks.en:
We model a multi-agent self-improvement pipeline as a finite tuple of programs together with a fixed interaction protocol.
Let 𝒜 = ( P , R , O , Π ) \mathcal{A}=(P,R,O,\Pi) denote a system consisting of a proposer P P , a reviewer (or gate component) R R , an orchestrator O O (which routes messages, runs tests, and applies updates), and a protocol Π \Pi that specifies how these components interact over discrete time steps.
On each round, the orchestrator provides inputs (task instances, tests, prompts, or environment states) to the components, collects their outputs, and produces an observable transcript.

blocks.en: A.2 Encoding a multi-agent system as a single program
blocks.zh: A.2 将多代理系统编码为单一程序

blocks.en:
Because each component is a program and the protocol Π \Pi is fixed, the joint behavior of 𝒜 \mathcal{A} can be implemented by a single program that simulates the interaction internally.
Concretely, define a compiler (an effective transformation) that maps any tuple ( P , R , O , Π ) (P,R,O,\Pi) to a single program index ⟨ P , R , O , Π ⟩ \langle P,R,O,\Pi\rangle which:
(i) simulates the protocol Π \Pi step-by-step,
(ii) runs the component programs on the appropriate messages, and
(iii) outputs the same external behavior (actions, transcript, or final decision) as the original multi-agent system.
blocks.zh:
由于每个组件都是一个程序,并且协议\\\\Pi是固定的,A\mathcal{A}的联合行为可以通过一个模拟内部相互作用的单一程序来执行.
具体来说,定义一个编译器(一个有效的转换),将任何调图(P, R, O, ) (P, R, O,\ Pi)映射到一个单一的程序索引 QQ P, R, O,\\\ langle P, R, O,\ Pi\rangle 中:
(一)模拟协议 \\ Pi逐步,
(二) 在适当信息上实施组成部分方案,以及
(三)输出与原多代理系统相同的外部行为(动作,笔录,或最终决定).

blocks.en:
This is standard: multi-tape machines, communicating processes, and modular code can be compiled into a single Turing machine with only polynomial overhead.
Therefore, any semantic score assigned to the multi-agent system (e.g., success probability, reward, correctness of a scientific claim) can be treated as a semantic score of the compiled single program.
In particular, if we define a semantic score functional over composite systems, we can equivalently define a semantic score over their single-program encodings.
blocks.zh:
这是标准的:多磁带机,交流过程,模块代码可以编译为单图灵机,只有多诺米机头.
因此,分配给多剂系统的任何语义分数(如成功概率,奖励,科学主张的正确性)都可以作为编译的单一程序的语义分数.
特别是,如果我们在复合系统上定义一个语义分数功能,我们可以在他们的单程序编码上等同地定义一个语义分数.

blocks.en: A.3 Why the diagonal channel persists in multi-agent form
blocks.zh: A.3 联合国 为什么对角通道以多剂形式存在

blocks.en:
The negative results rely on a structural ingredient: the candidate update can be chosen so that its behavior depends on the gate’s output.
In a multi-agent pipeline, such dependence can be realized through interaction in several natural ways:
blocks.zh:
负面结果依赖于结构成分:可以选择候选人更新,使其行为依赖于门的输出.
在多物剂管道中,这种依赖可以通过几种自然的相互作用来实现:

blocks.en: • Direct query access. The proposer can explicitly query the reviewer (or a proxy of the gate) during generation (e.g., “would this be accepted?”). • Outcome feedback. Even without explicit queries, the proposer can adapt using accept/reject outcomes from previous rounds. • Transcript leakage. If reviewer comments or rubric scores are revealed, the proposer can learn a predictive model of acceptance and condition on it.
blocks.zh: • 直接查询。 提议者可以在一代人期间明确询问审查者(或大门的代名词)(例如,“这是否被接受?” )。 • 结果反馈。 即使没有明确的询问,提议者也可以使用前几轮的接受/拒绝结果进行调整. • 记录漏损。 如果审查者评论或标点分数被披露,提议者可以学习一个预测性的接受模式及其条件.

blocks.zh: 直接查询访问. 提议者可以在一代人期间明确询问审查者(或大门的代名词)(例如,“这是否被接受?” )。

blocks.zh: 结果反馈。 即使没有明确的询问,提议者也可以使用前几轮的接受/拒绝结果进行调整.

blocks.zh: 译经渗漏. 如果审查者评论或标点分数被披露,提议者可以学习一个预测性的接受模式及其条件.

blocks.en:
Any of these channels allows the proposer to implement a “flip on accept” strategy: construct a candidate P ′ P^{\prime} whose behavior under evaluation depends on whether G ⁡ ( 𝒜 , P ′ ) G(\mathcal{A},P^{\prime}) would accept it.
Intuitively, the proposer uses the gate as an oracle (directly or indirectly), creating a self-referential loop routed through other agents.
blocks.zh:
任何这些渠道都允许提议者实施“接受”策略:构建一个候选人P ' P^{\prime}其行为是否受到评价取决于G (A,P′) G(\mathcal{A},P^{\prime})是否会接受。
直观上,提议者将门作为甲骨文(直接或间接),通过其他代理来创建自我优惠的环路.

blocks.en: A.4 A proof via reduction to the single-program setting
blocks.zh: A.4 联合国 通过简化到单一程序设置的证明

blocks.en:
We make the reduction from a fixed multi-agent pipeline to the single-program setting explicit and then apply
Kleene’s Recursion Theorem.

blocks.en: A.5 When the extension does not apply

blocks.en:
The diagonal channel requires that the candidate update can condition on the gate, either by querying it, observing outcomes, or learning from transcripts.
If the system is designed so that candidates are generated independently of the gate (no feedback, no shared transcript, no ability to model the reviewer), then the self-referential construction is blocked.
However, this restriction is strong and typically corresponds either to highly conservative pipelines or to bounded regimes where the gate’s guarantees are explicitly limited to a fixed evaluation horizon and finite proposal budget.

The finite horizon keeps the tree finite in depth.
The finite action and observation sets keep the branching finite.
The per-step cap makes the agent’s behavior at each node computable, since without it a single step could diverge.
The rational values matter for the comparisons.
If rewards or probabilities are arbitrary computable reals, the score can still be approximated to any precision, but deciding the strict inequality J int ​ ( q ) > J int ​ ( p ) J^{\mathrm{int}}(q)>J^{\mathrm{int}}(p) is no longer possible in general, because equality of computable reals is undecidable.
In that case a one-sided design remains available, for example accepting only when an approximation certifies a gap of at least a known margin.
